senses.sense_definition: iets met de handen en vingers volledig doorzoeken of bevoelen om iets te vinden

examples.text: De politie moest het donkere huis volledig <w>doortasten</w> op zoek naar bewijs.

target_lang_translations.en: The police had to thoroughly <w>search</w> the dark house for evidence.

examples.text: Na de storm gingen vrijwilligers het strand <w>doortasten</w> naar vermiste spullen.

target_lang_translations.en: After the storm, volunteers went to <w>search</w> the beach for missing belongings.

target_lang_definitions.en: to thoroughly search or feel through something with the hands and fingers in order to find something

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to search a place or object carefully and completely, often by feeling around with the hands
to feel through something carefully with the hands in order to find something
to examine by touch all over

senses.sense_definition: krachtig en beslissend handelen om iets vooruit te brengen of op te lossen

examples.text: De nieuwe directeur wil eindelijk stevig <w>doortasten</w> bij de hervorming van het bedrijf.

target_lang_translations.en: The new director finally wants to <w>act decisively</w> in reforming the company.

examples.text: Als de problemen blijven groeien, moet de regering snel <w>doortasten</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: If the problems keep growing, the government must <w>take firm action</w> quickly.

target_lang_definitions.en: to act forcefully and decisively in order to move something forward or resolve it

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to act firmly and effectively in order to make progress or solve a problem
to take strong, practical action instead of hesitating
to move ahead resolutely with a plan or solution
to deal with something energetically and directly
